TC-09/S08.title: A resident on today's list who is not on the photo is not dropped from today without a word
TC-09/S08.detail: Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S08's core cell is Q1 (open), so it is recorded, not judged: after scanning a one-row photo (QA TC-09-S08 Alder) and 'Add 1 to Today's Visits', the fixture resident who was In Today and not on the photo is no longer on Today's Visits (backend inTodaysSession false), and nothing warned before the write — against the UAT's 'the photo adds residents' / AC 3 'never silently dropping' this would be a Fail; snf.replaceTodaysList replaces today's list by design. The judged side cells pass 7/7 (setup included): Alder joins Today's Visits (exactly once), both stay in All Residents (U5), no Hospital patient. Decision for Daniela: Q1 (same as TC-02 Q6, draft #6(a)).
